comparison.objective: Safely isolate an opened battery pack and remove busbars and nuts; candidate commissions a shock absorber under lockout.
comparison.physical_skill: Service-plug extraction, live-dead-live meter use, insulated nut removal and conductive-part control versus fine setscrew and collar manipulation followed by guarded tests.
comparison.success_condition: Pack proven dead before disassembly and no conductive item bridges terminals versus two safe damping cycles after de-energized adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both enforce safety sequencing, but electrical isolation and hazardous disassembly are materially different from passive-damper tuning.
